title: Borani Esfenaj (Persian Spinach and Yoghurt Dip)
summary: Spinach wilted with golden fried onion, garlic and turmeric, cooked dry, then folded into Greek yoghurt with lemon and chilled; served with olive oil and mint.

ingredients.item: extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt
plain yoghurt, plus extra to thin
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Brown the onion
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 6-8 min, stirring, until golden brown. Turn the heat to medium-low, add the garlic for 2 min, then the turmeric for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Add half the spinach and toss with tongs over medium heat until wilted, then add the rest with 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper. Cook for 3-5 min until wilted and all the liquid has evaporated, so the dip will not turn watery. Tip into the bowl and cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir in the Greek yoghurt, plain yoghurt, lemon zest, lemon juice and remaining salt, thinning with a little more plain yoghurt if it is very thick.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 24. Stir, spoon into the serving bowl, drizzle with oil and top with mint leaves. Serve with flatbread.

tips: Squeeze any remaining liquid from the cooled spinach before mixing it in.
Chop the cooled spinach if you prefer a smoother dip.
A few chopped walnuts on top add crunch.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Stir before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
